card.name: Start of words beginning with F
card.fires_on: Fires on a word-initial F or f just before the rest of a word, such as Fentanyl, FPG or Fairewinds. It also fires on a few small linking words like 'of', 'with' or 'recommending' in opioid or risk phrases.

modes.label: Lone F before fentanyl
modes.description: A bare F or f that starts the drug name fentanyl.
modes.example: Dose Conversion from Other Opioids to<< F>>entanyl Transdermal System Current Analges

modes.label: F in FPG
modes.description: The letter F that begins the abbreviation FPG for fasting plasma glucose.
modes.example: The therapeutic goal in all patients with type 2 diabetes is to decrease<< F>>PG, PPG, and Hb

modes.label: Linking word in therapy phrases
modes.description: A verb or small word just before a drug or risk term in opioid or treatment instructions.
modes.example: strongly consider<< recommending>> or prescribing an overdose reversal agent for the

card.writes: It lowers the odds of next tokens starting with g and raises odd unrelated tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the first letter F in words like fentanyl or FPG, where the rest of the word comes next.
